```r
[library](https://rdrr.io/r/base/library.html)([data.table](https://r-datatable.com))
[library](https://rdrr.io/r/base/library.html)([HistData](https://friendly.github.io/HistData/))
 [set.seed](https://rdrr.io/r/base/Random.html)(1983)
galton <- [as.data.table](https://rdatatable.gitlab.io/data.table/reference/as.data.table.html)(GaltonFamilies)[gender == "male", .SD[[sample](https://rdrr.io/r/base/sample.html)(.N, 1)], by = family]
galton <- galton[, .(father, son = childHeight)]
```

```r
beta1 <- [seq](https://rdrr.io/r/base/seq.html)(0, 1, length = [nrow](https://rdrr.io/r/base/nrow.html)(galton))
results <- [data.frame](https://rdrr.io/r/base/data.frame.html)(beta1 = beta1, rss = [sapply](https://rdrr.io/r/base/lapply.html)(beta1, rss, beta0 = 25))
results |> ggplot(aes(beta1, rss)) + geom_line() + 
 geom_line(aes(beta1, rss))
```
